title: India may mandate battery storage for new RE
summary: India plans to mandate ​battery storage for ​all new government solar and wind projects ​from July 2027, to ensure green power can be stored and dispatched when needed, according to draft regulations.India plans ‌to mandate ⁠two-hour ⁠battery storage equivalent to at least 10% of capacity for ​all new solar and onshore wind projects commissioned after July ​1 next year, the draft regulations produced by the Central Electricity Authority showed.The requirement would become ​more stringent from July 2029, when ⁠the minimum ‌storage duration would increase to ​four hours, ​while retaining the 10%
